name: VR Viewer for DJI Osmo 360
summary:
VR Viewer for DJI Osmo 360 turns your Meta Quest into a 360° cinema for your Osmo 360 footage.

WATCH
• Plays the camera's original .OSV files directly — no DJI Studio, no PC, no export.
• Connect the camera with a USB-C cable (Transfer File: USB) or plug in its SD card with a card reader.
• Stabilized with the camera's own motion data: the horizon stays level and the view holds still.
• Slow fast action down to ½ or ¼ speed.
• Full-quality pause: the frame is rebuilt at full resolution — look around and zo
